content: आवसथ्य {%a.%} [आवसथ-ञ्य] Being in a house. .{@-थ्यः@} The sacred fire kept in the house, one of the five fires used in sacrifices; see पञ्चाग्नि; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 13. 37</ls>. .{@-थ्यः, -थ्यम्@} A dwelling for pupils and ascetics. .{@-थ्यम्@} .²1 Placing a sacred fire within a house. .²2 A house.
